title: Sensei Ledger Row (one append to SENSEI_LEDGER.jsonl)
description: Versioned contract for a single SENSEI_LEDGER.jsonl line, written by bin/sensei_writeback.py (Python) and tail-read by api/src/server.ts GET /api/sensei/ledger plus bin/sensei_prep.py's REFUTED-in-24h skip. The row is FLAT: rival_verdict is a field here, not a nested verdict object — the rival agent's own {verdict, confidence, reasoning, evidence, mode} envelope crosses the wire to POST /api/reflex/verdicts and is not what lands in this file. Draft-07 is mandatory, not stylistic: ajv 6.15.0 (api/package.json) rejects 2020-12 outright while Python jsonschema 4.26 accepts it, so a 2020-12 schema passes the Python tests and silently fails on the TS side.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC append time. sensei_writeback stamps this itself, overriding any caller value.

cycle_id.description: UUID of the sensei cycle that produced the row. Groups every row of one cycle and is the watermark sensei_prep reads to bound the post-audit scan.

reflex_id.description: Reflex the row is about, e.g. metric:bow:Error_Rate. Post-audit rows carry the reflex_id of the audited exec_log entry.

pillar.description: The pillar the row is about. NULL only on `heartbeat` rows: a heartbeat is about the CYCLE, not any pillar, and inventing one would make an empty cycle look like pillar work.

scout_verdict.description: Free-text summary of the ronin finding (real: true/false + fixability). Prose by contract — the structured form lives in scout_finding.schema.json. NULL on post_audit rows: SKILL.md Step 2 spawns rival directly against exec_log entries, so no scout ever ran (1 of the 10 real rows).

rival_verdict.description: The adversarial verifier's call. REFUTED here is what suppresses the reflex for 24h in sensei_prep, so the vocabulary is closed. NULL when no rival ran — Step 4 only spawns rival for findings with real:true, so suppressed/escalated phantom and structural findings legitimately have no verdict (6 of the 10 real rows). Null is 'not verified', never 'verified inconclusive' — that is SUSPECT.

action_taken.description: What the cycle actually did. verdict_post_failed is written by sensei_writeback when the POST fails after the row was planned as verdict_posted — the ledger never claims a post that didn't happen. `heartbeat` is the explicit no-op: one row appended by a cycle that produced no verdicts and no post-audit rows, so ledger freshness measures LIVENESS (did the loop run) and cannot be satisfied by silence. It carries rival_verdict:null, so the rival-verdicts-flowing check still measures verdicts only.

human_flag.description: True when the row needs human review: SUSPECT verdicts, and any reflex whose rival could not run even on the fallback model.

detail.description: Optional operator note. Present on 2 of the 10 real rows.

then.description: The one cross-field invariant the seam actually needs: a row cannot claim it posted a verdict it never had. SKILL.md Step 6 posts only CONFIRMED and REFUTED (SUSPECT is skipped, human_flag only), so a verdict_posted row with a null or SUSPECT rival_verdict means the POST and the ledger disagree — the exact silent divergence sensei_writeback's post-then-record ordering exists to prevent.
